neighbours.label: Anaphoric 'that' standing for a repeated noun in a comparison ('similar to that of', 'greater than that found'), vs complementizer and relative 'that'
fire: The climate of the island is much milder than that of the mainland.
Her salary is now close to that of a senior manager.
The bird's call resembles that of a creaking door.
The new engine's output is double that of the old model.
His style of painting is quite different from that of his teacher.
The population of the town is smaller than that recorded in 1900.
The flavour of the fruit is similar to that of a ripe pear.
Their success was matched only by that of their rivals.
quiet: The climate of the island is much milder than the mainland.
Everyone agreed that her salary is close to a manager's.
The bird that lives in our garden sings every morning.
The engineer said that the engine is twice as strong now.
His style of painting is quite different from his teacher's.
The town that we visited in 1900 photos looked smaller.
The flavour of the fruit reminds me of a ripe pear.
I knew that their success would surprise their rivals.

predictions: Comparative anaphoric 'that' 0.35-0.6; complementizer/relative 'that' and comparisons without it under 0.12.
notes: Card broad; peaks ' that' x14 ('similar to that of', 'surpassed only by that of', 'greater than that found'). Probe: 'similar to that of silk' 0.555, 'greater than that found on Earth' 0.484, 'such as that of rare diseases' 0.411, 'in relation to that of his rival' 0.397; 'similar to silk' 0.112, complementizer 'said that' 0.093, relative 'the book that I read' 0.046.
